sources.title: Flames' Joel Farabee: Stays hot with two points

findings.note: In an Oct 27, 2026 RotoWire item, Farabee had a goal and an assist in a 5-2 win over Toronto. That stretched his point streak to five games, with 11 points in 11 games, six of them on the power play.

The Flames' site recap from about Oct 22-23 lists Farabee on the top line with Ben Jones and Matt Coronato. It also says he led Calgary forwards in shorthanded ice time, so he is getting heavy minutes.

Last season Farabee had 38 points in 82 games, with several multi-game point droughts, playing middle-six minutes on a low-scoring Calgary team. That past scoring rate is the main case for the Under. No injury news showed up in these results.
